Transaction replay scheduler with account-conflict DAGs, staging lanes, and EMA-based scoring

# Purpose
This file implements `fd_rdisp`, a transaction dispatch scheduler that builds and maintains account-conflict DAGs for multiple staging lanes. It stores transactions in a fixed-size pool and tracks account references with compact edge records, per-account metadata, and per-block state. The code supports adding blocks, promoting and demoting blocks between staged and unstaged states, selecting a staging lane, inserting transactions, choosing the next ready transaction, and completing transactions while updating dependency counts and account reference links.

The file also defines the internal data structures and memory layout used by the scheduler, including `fd_rdisp_txn_t`, `acct_info_t`, `fd_rdisp_blockinfo_t`, and the `fd_rdisp_t` context. It uses generated pool, list, map, and priority-queue helpers to avoid dynamic allocation during normal operation. In addition, it maintains per-account EMA values to guide scheduling order, and it includes verification logic in [`fd_rdisp_verify`](<#fd_rdisp_verify>) to check that the stored dependency graph and in-degree counts are consistent.
